mentions.name: DailySelfTrack
mentions.description: DailySelfTrack is a customizable combination of habit tracker, health journal and diary. It aims to be as powerful as a spreadsheet for self-tracking while keeping daily usability on par with a habit tracker app, supporting flexible journaling (e.g., gratitude, bullet-point journal), health analysis of how things relate across multiple health issues, and goal progress with features like daily focus sessions, no-phone mornings, and language learning.
mentions.problem: Self-tracking tools trade off power and usability: spreadsheets are powerful but cumbersome, while habit trackers are easy but limited; the author also needs to understand how multiple health issues relate to each other.
mentions.source_excerpt:
DailySelfTrack app: https://dailyselftrack.com/

DailySelfTrack is  a customizable combination of habit tracker, health journal and diary.

It should be as powerful as a spreadsheet for self-tracking, but the daily usability should be more on par with a habit tracker app.

mentions.name: DailySelfTrack
mentions.description: A local-first self-tracking app that combines a habit tracker, health log, and journal for tracking what matters to you. It works like a spreadsheet app with better UX and offers greater customization than typical habit or health apps, with no subscription or dark patterns.
mentions.problem: The author couldn't find a satisfying self-tracking solution anywhere, so they built their own.
mentions.audience: People who have complex health issues, are working towards ambitious goals, or just want to regularly reflect on their day.
mentions.source_excerpt: Also working on DailySelfTrack ( https://dailyselftrack.com/ ), an app to track what matters to you in a way that you find relevant. So it is a mix of habit tracker, health log and journal. Like a spreadhsheet app, but with much better UX. And like a habit/health app, but with much greater customization.
